name: Gathering
desc: Send a companion to gather materials for the next camp upgrade.
progress: Searching for materials to upgrade the camp.
return_message: returns from gathering materials carrying supplies and has a bit more experience…

name: Collect Firewood
desc: Send a companion to gather light brush and stout branches.
return_message: returns from gathering materials carrying supplies and has a bit more experience…

name: Sorting
desc: Send a companion to do low level chores and sort supplies.
effects: Material left in the unsorted loot zone will be sorted into a defined loot zone.
depart_message: goes off to clean toilets and sort loot.
return_message: returns from doing the dirty work to keep the camp running…

name: Cut Logs
desc: Send a companion to a nearby forest to cut logs.
effects: 50% of trees/trunks at the forest position will be cut down.
100% of total material will be brought back.
Repeatable with diminishing returns.
Will eventually turn forests into fields.
time: 6 Hours Base + Travel Time + Cutting Time
return_message: returns from working in the woods…

name: Clear Cut
desc: Send a companion to clear a nearby forest.
effects: 95% of trees/trunks at the forest position will be cut down.
0% of total material will be brought back.
Forest should become a field tile.
Useful for clearing land for another faction camp.
time: 6 Hour Base + Travel Time + Cutting Time
footer: Note that it's likely both forest and field roads look exactly the same after having been cleared.
return_message: returns from working in the woods…

name: Setup Hide Site
desc: Send a companion to build an improvised shelter and stock it with equipment at a distant map location.
effects: Good for setting up resupply or contingency points.
Gear is left unattended and could be stolen.
Time dependent on weight of equipment being sent forward.
depart_message: departs to build a hide site…
return_message: returns from working on the hide site…

name: Relay Hide Site
desc: Push gear out to a hide site or bring gear back from one.
effects: Good for returning equipment you left in the hide site shelter.
Gear is left unattended and could be stolen.
Time dependent on weight of equipment being sent forward or back.
progress: Transferring gear to a hide site…
return_message: returns from shuttling gear between the hide site…

name: Foraging
desc: Send a companion to forage for edible plants.
items_possibilities: fruits and nuts depending on season
depart_message: departs to search for edible plants…
return_message: returns from foraging for edible plants carrying supplies and has a bit more experience…

name: Trapping
desc: Send a companion to set traps for small game.
footer: WARNING: May produce less food than consumed!
depart_message: departs to set traps for small animals…
return_message: returns from trapping small animals carrying supplies and has a bit more experience…

name: Hunting
desc: Send a companion to hunt large animals.
items_possibilities: small, medium, or large animal corpses
footer: WARNING: May produce less food than consumed!
return_message: returns from hunting for meat carrying supplies and has a bit more experience…

name: Recruiting
desc: Send a companion to search for survivors willing to join your camp.
return_message: returns from searching for recruits with a bit more experience…

name: Scouting
desc: Send a companion out into the great unknown.  High survival skills are needed to avoid combat but you should expect an encounter or two.
effects: Select checkpoints to customize path.
Reveals terrain around the path.
Can bounce off hide sites to extend range.

name: Combat Patrol
desc: Send a companion to purge the wasteland.  Their goal is to kill anything hostile they encounter and return when their wounds are too great or the odds are stacked against them.
effects: Pulls creatures encountered into combat instead of fleeing.
Select checkpoints to customize path.
Can bounce off hide sites to extend range.

name: Plowing
desc: Plow any spaces that have reverted to dirt or grass.
effects: Restores farm plots created in previous expansion upgrades.
Does not damage existing crops.

name: Planting
desc: Plant designated seeds in the spaces that have already been tilled.
effects: Choose which seed type or all of your seeds.
Stops when out of seeds or planting locations.
Will plant in ALL dirt mounds in the expansion.

name: Harvest
desc: Harvest any plants that are ripe and bring the produce back.
effects: Will dump all harvesting products onto your location.

name: Survey Field
desc: Nearby terrain can be turned into fields if it is completely cleared of terrain that isn't grass or dirt.  Doing so makes that terrain eligible for usage for standard base camp expansion.  Note that log cutting does this conversion automatically when the trees are depleted, but not all terrain can be logged.
effects: If the expansion direction selected is eligible for conversion into a field this mission will perform that conversion.  If it is not eligible you are told as much, and would have to make it suitable for conversion by removing everything that isn't grass or soil.  Mining zones are useful to remove pavement, for instance.  Note that removal of buildings is dangerous, laborious, and may still fail to get rid of everything if e.g. a basement or an opening to underground areas (such as a manhole) remains.
action_name: Survey terrain and try to convert it to Field
depart_message: departs to look for suitable fields…
return_message: stops looking for terrain to turn into fields…

name: Survey Expansion
desc: Expansions open up new opportunities but can be expensive and time-consuming.  Pick them carefully, at most 8 can be built at each camp.
effects: Choose any one of the available expansions.  Starting with a farm is always a solid choice since food is used to support companion missions and minimal investment is needed to get it going.  A forge is also a great idea, allowing you to refine resources for subsequent expansions, craft better gear and make charcoal.
return_message: returns from surveying for the expansion.
